label: Demon Slayer
description: Tanjiro Kamado's quest to cure his demon sister Nezuko and avenge his slaughtered family.

vocab.context: Water Breathing is the first style Tanjiro masters. Fluid, adaptable, and built on eleven distinct forms.
The Flame Pillar Rengoku embodies fire. Passionate, consuming, and heroic to the last breath.
Wind Breathing turns speed and wide cutting arcs into a deadly dance. The Wind Pillar Sanemi's signature style.
Insect Breathing, Shinobu's own creation, uses toxins rather than raw strength to fell demons.
Flower Breathing is a graceful yet lethal derivative style, wielded by Kanao Tsuyuri.
Demons only appear at night. Tanjiro and the Corps fight through every dark hour to protect humanity.
Surviving until morning means surviving the demon's most dangerous hours. Dawn is victory.
Tanjiro trained for two years on Urokodaki's mountain, honing every skill under brutal conditions.
Tanjiro never forgets that each demon was once human. A belief that defines his compassion and sorrow.
Tanjiro often extends a hand to dying demons, recognizing the person they once were.
Moon Breathing is Kokushibo's devastating style. The strongest demon aside from Muzan himself.
Tanjiro's entire journey begins with the loss of his family. And the promise to protect what remains.
As the eldest son, Tanjiro carries the weight of older brother. Protector, breadwinner, and avenger.
Nezuko, Tanjiro's younger sister, was turned into a demon. Yet remains the purest soul in the story.
Tanjiro proves that compassion amplifies strength. Real power comes from protecting others.
In every dying demon, Tanjiro sees a human heart that was corrupted. And grieves for it.
Nezuko wears a bamboo muzzle. Simultaneously a restraint and a symbol of trust between siblings.
Tanjiro cries for every demon he kills, mourning the person they could have been.
Rock Breathing, Gyomei's style, channels immovable strength through spiked flails rather than a blade.
Serpent Breathing mimics a snake's unpredictable fluid strikes. Obanai Iguro's lethal speciality.
Sound Breathing, Uzui Tengen's style, matches attack rhythms to music and explosive flamboyance.
Love Breathing channels intense emotion into fluid, powerful strikes. Mitsuri Kanroji's unique style.
Every character in Demon Slayer asks what true strength looks like. And gets a different answer.
Zenitsu's acknowledged weakness becomes a brutal strength once he stops fighting it.
The creatures Tanjiro hunts. Once human, now transformed by Muzan's blood into something terrifying.
Demons were created from Muzan's blood. And a single drop can begin a transformation.
Total Concentration Breathing is the foundation of all Demon Slayer combat. Mastering it is mastering life itself.
Rengoku's Flame Breathing burns with the intensity of a man who lives every moment to its fullest.
A Demon Slayer's sword is their lifeline. Each blade changes color to match its wielder's fighting spirit.
Each breathing style is divided into numbered forms. Tanjiro's mastery grows form by form, battle by battle.
The nine Hashira are the most powerful Demon Slayers. Pillars of the Corps and humanity's last line of defence.
Two years of relentless training under Urokodaki shaped Tanjiro from a coal seller into a Demon Slayer.
Tanjiro's techniques evolve throughout the series, each new form pushing the limits of human capability.
Tanjiro, Zenitsu, and Inosuke become inseparable nakama. Each covering the other's weaknesses.
Every Hashira is willing to sacrifice their life. The Corps runs on the fuel of human sacrifice.
Tanjiro's quest blends revenge with compassion. Unusual for an avenger, and defining for the series.
Zenitsu fights paralyzed by fear. Yet unleashes devastating power in that exact moment of terror.
Real courage, Tanjiro shows, isn't the absence of fear. It's acting despite overwhelming terror.
The bond between Tanjiro and Nezuko is pure love. The kind that doesn't break under any curse.
Dying demons often relive their final human memories. Tanjiro watches them return to who they were.
The Hinokami Kagura is described as a dance passed soul to soul across generations of the Kamado family.
Thunder Breathing lets Zenitsu move faster than the eye can see. All power compressed into one devastating form.
Nezuko's transformation is the central tragedy. But also the spark that ignites Tanjiro's entire journey.
Each Hashira's eyes reflect the same thing: absolute determination forged by personal tragedy.
Nezuko fights to protect humans even as a demon. Proving that humanity isn't lost with the body.
Nezuko surviving as a demon who protects humans gives the Corps the first real hope of defeating Muzan.
Each Demon Slayer's past is a wound. The Corps is built from people who refuse to let that wound be wasted.
Yaiba. Blade. Is half the show's Japanese title 鬼滅の刃: the blade of demon slaying.
The only way to kill a demon: behead it with a Nichirin Blade in a single clean stroke.
Demons regenerate from almost any wound. Making decapitation the only reliable kill method.
Total Concentration Breathing means filling lungs to absolute capacity. Maintaining it 24/7 is the Hashira standard.
The Hinokami Kagura is a sacred breathing dance inherited through the Kamado family across generations.
Shinobu Kocho fights with wisteria-derived poison. Injected through needle-fine thrusts against demons.
Metsu. Extermination. Is half the show's Japanese title 鬼滅の刃: the blade of demon extermination.
The Demon Slayer Mark awakens in the most powerful fighters, granting superhuman speed at a terrible cost.
Demon Slayers receive a Kasugai Crow. A messenger bird that relays mission orders from Corps headquarters.
Sanemi's consuming hatred of demons contrasts with Tanjiro's empathy. Both born from the same kind of loss.
Behind every Demon Slayer is a story of grief. It is the Corps' unofficial entrance exam.
The Swordsmith Village reveals both sword-forging and the spiritual tempering that Demon Slayers must undergo.
Tanjiro's strength grows through accumulated training, pain, and the inherited will of those who came before.
The Demon Slayer Corps has teetered on the brink of annihilation for generations, kept alive by sheer will.
Tanjiro's awakening to Sun Breathing is the series' emotional climax. The final piece of his ancestor's legacy.
Forged from Scarlet Ore that absorbs sunlight, Nichirin Blades are the only swords capable of killing demons.

meanings.es: Cuerpo de los Cazadores de Demonios

vocab.context: The Demon Slayer Corps is a secret organization predating the government, fighting demons for centuries.
Blood Demon Arts are unique supernatural powers that Upper Rank demons develop. Each one terrifyingly different.
The Hinokami Kagura is the Kamado family's sacred dance. And the hidden origin of Sun Breathing itself.
The Twelve Kizuki are Muzan's twelve most powerful demons. Ranked by numbers engraved in their eyes.
Jōchū means maintaining Total Concentration Breathing even while asleep. The true mark of a Hashira.
The Transparent World lets a fighter see an opponent's muscles, blood flow, and next move before it happens.
Wisteria is toxic to demons. Villages plant it as borders and Shinobu infuses it in her poison blades.
Tanjiro's extraordinary sense of smell lets him track demons, sense emotions, and even predict enemy moves.
